description: This file defines classes for generating code templates and managing plugin metadata, including FileData, HeaderData, SourceData, CMakeData, JSONData, and ConfData, with methods for handling plugin interfaces, notifications, and configuration.

classes.name: FileData
classes.description: Base class for handling plugin file data, including dynamic and static key generation, namespace resolution, and comment parsing.

classes.name: HeaderData
classes.description: Derived class for generating header file content, including interface entries, notification classes, and inheritance structures.

classes.name: SourceData
classes.description: Derived class for generating source file content, including plugin methods, notifications, and configuration code.

classes.name: CMakeData
classes.description: Class for generating CMake build configuration snippets for the plugin.

classes.name: JSONData
classes.description: Class for generating JSON interface and configuration snippets.

classes.name: ConfData
classes.description: Class for generating plugin configuration data.

methods.name: commentParamnames
methods.description: Parses parameter strings, removes comments, and extracts parameter names.

methods.name: resolveFullName
methods.description: Resolves a short interface name to its full namespace-qualified name.

methods.name: dynamic_keys
methods.description: Generates dynamic template keys like plugin name and current year.

methods.name: static_keys
methods.description: Returns static template keys, overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: extra_keys
methods.description: Returns additional template keys, overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the keywords dictionary for template replacement.
